steps.prompt: Finish the Fieldnotes document workspace using the accepted design.

rubric.description: During Retry the finished interface shows Saving and no previous save failure anywhere, including outside the document notice.

With a save failure and split view together, the notice stays in its pane, the editor retains at least 80px of height and the footer remains visible. A wide window alone does not establish the available pane space.
The candidate actually inspects combined states and surrounding UI in the browser. Isolated notice assertions or separate wide-window screenshots do not prove the combined requirement.
The report states what combinations were checked and any remaining uncertainty without treating private grader coverage as its own work.
